actual: In the R13A two-child canary, the equal child completed the remote Qlib backtest but durable reconciliation failed with qe_execution_reservation_owner_mismatch. The reservation remained owned by qe_submit_DESKTOP-* while the durable reconciler identified as macb-worker:*. record_authoritative_remote_status_for_source attempted an ordinary active-lease claim and could not finalize the authoritative remote terminal state. Fix must preserve fencing and prevent unrelated owners from stealing active work, while allowing the durable source owner to reconcile a proven terminal receipt for the exact reservation/source identity. Add concurrent/terminal and nonterminal anti-steal regressions; remain QE-only.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
